vercelServerArchitecture.details: Client-side SPA serves cleanly on Vercel static hosting. Express backend routes in server.ts can be deployed as Vercel Serverless Functions via /api rewrites without requiring an external container host.
vercelServerArchitecture.isolationAndFallback: Drive and Sheets integrations act as secondary projection layers. Core application functionality relies on Firestore as source-of-truth and operates 100% without Drive/Sheets enabled.
